title: Romantic Getaway to Russia: A Couple's Guide for 2026

content:
Russia is one of those places that stays with you long after you leave. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Russia, the experience is nothing short of transformative.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Russia
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Russia](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1520106212299-d99c443e4568?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of Russia's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Boutique hotels in Russia offer intimate settings with personalized service perfect for couples.
